id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1811: "Wheeze... pant... making me run to drain my strength, that monster is quite sharp!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|181b: "Ugh... if I were forty years younger, I'd take care of such a monster with a single Zap...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|182e: "I bet it fled in fear of my Zap... wheeze, pant...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|183a: "Whew, that was close. If I'd cast Zap on Cynthia, it would have been terrible.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1843: "It's thanks to you, traveler. Thank you for stopping me.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1862: "Traveler, listen! I look like a Slime now, but... I'm not really a Slime!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|186d: "My name is Cynthia! I'm an ordinary girl who lives in this village!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1876: "I was practicing Morph, which I learned recently, by turning into a Slime, when a monster I'd never seen appeared.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1885: "It cast a strange spell on me and left. And now... I can't return to my original form.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1892: "People here have a duty to protect their loved ones, so outsiders are rarely let in, and monsters are out of the question.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18a4: "If villagers catch me like this, I don't know what will happen to me... So I want to undo this spell somehow.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18b2: "Please, traveler. Will you lend me your strength?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18c3: "...I see, you're busy. I'm confident in my stamina, so I'll try to keep running a bit more.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18d1: "If you change your mind, call out to me. ...Pant, pant. See you then.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18e6: "...Oh, thank you! Right away, kind traveler, have you heard of the great sage's staff?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18f3: "The great sage's staff is full of holy power that drives off evil attacks, and can be made by mysterious smithing.

id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1901: "With that great sage's staff, the cursed spell on me should be lifted.

id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|190c: "So please, traveler. If you get the great sage's staff, bring it to me.

id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|196a: "...By the way, your hair is so silky. Totally different from my friend's.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1975: "My friend has curly hair, green like a meadow. I love her hair.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|199c: "This is the Lost Woods where fairies live. A passage to the fairy world that lures in and traps those who enter...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19ab: "But trouble's afoot. Flowers in this forest turned into monsters and scattered sleeping pollen...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19bb: "Yawn... and that's how I ended up like this. Everyone living in this forest was hit by a ferocious sleepiness and fell asleep...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19c7: "My biggest worry is the fairies. Adults can't see them, so I have no idea how they are...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19d4: "If all the fairies fall asleep, the path to the fairy world will be closed. I have to do something quick... zzz.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19e1: "...Oops! Anyway! You look pretty strong, so could you defeat that flower monster...?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19f5: "I see... asking a stranger may have been too bold. Sorry... zzz.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a0b: "You'll... mumble... do it? There are real softies in this world. Well, I'm glad... drowsy, drowsy.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a16: "The monster that spread the sleeping pollen is deep in this forest. But this is the Lost Woods... getting there is very hard...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a25: "If we could ask the fairies for guidance it'd be easy... but fairies can only be seen by children...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a32: "Anyway, I'm counting on you. To save us and the fairies, take care of that flower monster... zzz.

id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a9b: "Yawn... ow, ow, ow. After lying on the ground so long, my body aches.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1aa4: "But thanks to you defeating the monster, I could wake up. The fairies should be relieved too.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ab0: "I have to thank you. Here, take this.

id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ac4: "You've helped me so much. No amount of thanks is enough. Take care on your journey.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ad5: "They say only pure-hearted people can see fairies. That's why innocent children can see them.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ae4: "...Hm? You couldn't see them either? Well, that's proof of growing up fine. That's how everyone becomes an adult.

id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bd2: "Oh dear. I slept so long my stomach is growling. Maybe I'll make something tasty.

id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bdf: "Well, well! Is that a mystic branch? Getting such a rare thing, you must have worked hard.

id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c1e: "A legendary Pegasus is enshrined here. But all that's in this tower now is an empty shell.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c2a: "For some reason, the Pegasus's heart and body were separated.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c32: "If the Pegasus's heart returns, it should be able to return to its original form. We've all been waiting for that day.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c41: "If the old man were gone, we wouldn't get fed. Thanks for helping him!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c60: "Neigh, what a pickle, what a pickle. What should I do...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c65: "...Ah, are you a traveler?! Sorry to ask so suddenly, but would you hear this horse's story?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c71: "This place is called Pegasus Tower, a sacred tower where a statue of the legendary Pegasus is enshrined.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c7e: "The tower is managed by an old man who loves horses, and I'm that old man's horse.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c88: "Actually, that old man climbed Pegasus Tower a long time ago and hasn't come back at all.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c93: "The Pegasus statue at the top is said to regain its true form when it faces its true self...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ca4: "I'm so worried something happened to the Pegasus statue and the old man got caught up in it!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cb1: "Please, could you check on the old man at the top of the tower?
